acceptance_checks: No reversal signal can appear before an external anchor sweep is detected.
No entry-ready state can appear without a reclaim and CISD sequence in that order.
When wick-midpoint respect is enabled, a midpoint breach cancels or downgrades the reversal path before entry-ready.
Aggressive body-based invalidation must be visibly labeled as tighter-risk mode and cannot replace the stored structural invalidation anchor.
The script must stay bar-close confirmed and avoid intrabar-only transitions.
The implementation should stay within the configured request-security budget and avoid unbounded multi-timeframe fan-out.
Backtest results must include spread, slippage, commission, and fee assumptions before performance is treated as credible.
Historical execution must assume next-bar-open entry after a confirmed bar-close signal instead of intrabar lookahead fills.
If stop and target touch in the same bar, assume the stop prints first unless lower-timeframe replay evidence proves the target filled first.

open_implementation_questions.question: What is the cleanest first-pass CISD definition for reversal confirmation without discretionary candle reading?
What is the cleanest first-pass reclaim or inversion rule when the move back through the extreme is shallow or fast?
What machine proxy best separates bulk opposing candles from wick-dominant swings before allowing body-based invalidation?

pine_translation_hints: Prefer bar-close confirmation over intrabar discretion.
Keep lower-timeframe requests focused and finite.
Represent structure and invalidation as explicit state objects.

provisional_proxies.logic: After a bullish low sweep, require a close back above the swept anchor; after a bearish high sweep, require a close back below the swept anchor. Alternate mode allows a close back inside the source range instead.

Define the impulse into the sweep as the contiguous run of same-direction candles ending at the sweep bar. Bullish CISD fires on the first close above the highest body edge of the last bearish impulse bar in that cluster; bearish CISD is the mirror rule below the lowest body edge of the last bullish impulse bar.
Allow body-based invalidation only when the confirming swing candle is not wick-dominant and reward-to-risk at the structural stop is below the minimum threshold.

signal_pipeline.logic: Compute higher-timeframe continuation or reversal bias first and reject lower-timeframe reversal setups that directly fight a clean higher-timeframe continuation state.
signal_pipeline.name: Higher-Timeframe Bias Gate

signal_pipeline.logic: Track previous-day, previous-week, session, and swing anchors, prioritize the higher-timeframe anchor on overlap, and mark a reversal candidate only after an external sweep.
signal_pipeline.name: Anchor Selection and Sweep Detection

signal_pipeline.logic: Require the rejection wick to remain valid by midpoint logic, then require a reclaim back through the swept reference or back inside the source range.
signal_pipeline.name: Wick and Reclaim Filter

signal_pipeline.logic: After reclaim, require a first-pass CISD proxy and then a newly confirmed opposite-direction protected swing before advancing the sequence to structural validity.
signal_pipeline.name: CISD and Protected-Swing Confirmation

signal_pipeline.logic: Enable fair-value-gap, candle-three-equilibrium, or breaker-style entries only after structural confirmation, then screen them by the selected invalidation mode and minimum reward-to-risk.
signal_pipeline.name: Entry Family and Risk Filter

signal_pipeline.logic: Plot previous-day equilibrium or nearby opposing liquidity as the first target, extend to external liquidity when momentum stays intact, and invalidate the setup when structure degrades into range or opposite follow-through.
signal_pipeline.name: Target and Failure Management

transitions.condition: A tracked external liquidity anchor is swept during the active kill zone and higher-timeframe bias does not block the reversal hypothesis.
Price closes back through the swept reference or back inside the source range according to the selected reclaim proxy.

A new protected swing confirms and at least one enabled entry family becomes valid with acceptable reward-to-risk.
Price fails the active invalidation level, loses directional follow-through, or degrades into range behavior before target progression.
